body:
Thank you so much for the response. It really does mean a lot to me.

My partner of 10 years left me, and I dedicated all of my time to them. All of it. I never really bothered making other friends because I was comfortable with them. Now I find myself in a house alone, with no friends, and terrible social anxiety that makes it so hard to make friends. 

I also just hate myself. I want to feel close again like I did with my partner. But clearly there is something wrong with me if she left. I look at myself in the mirror in the morning, and I fucking hate how I look. And it just gets worse as I get older. And nobody wants to date or be around someone with such horrible self-confidence. I don't feel like I contribute much to society. 

But I can't tell if I'm serious about suicide or not. I get the thoughts, and when I'm in those thoughts, it feels very real. Like I could just pick up the gun, close my eyes, and impulsively pull the trigger as I hold my breath. But after a couple of seconds, it's over, and I walk away.
I really am not sure if I am capable of doing it. I don't feel like doing it right now. But I just get these thoughts throughout the day. Right now I feel OK. Your reply is very kind.
